description: S458 F1: the §55.1 shared-core vocabulary inside a refinement predicate (`number(min(0) && max(100))`, the §55.3 example form) is not yet read by impl#1 in refinement-type position. Before S458 it read as the unknown shape `min` and compiled to a runtime check of `(true && true)`; it is now refused with E-CONTRACT-002 rather than silently unenforced. How shared-core vocabulary is read in type position is an open ruling (R4 in docs/changes/s458-refinement-every-position/PLAN.md); this case pins today's fail-closed behaviour and migrates with that ruling.
rationale: §53.6.1: a refinement-position predicate is a "Compile-time + runtime boundary check" — a predicate the compiler cannot evaluate cannot be that check, so it fails closed until R4 is ruled.
